captions.detailed: A light-gray window box fan assembly consisting of a thick rectangular outer frame (housing) and an inner sliding frame. Inside the inner frame, a thin safety grille of intersecting vertical and horizontal bars protects a central fan with three rotating blades. On the side of the inner frame is a vertical rectangular slider bar that serves as a vent adjuster.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a window box fan with three main moving parts: a prismatic outer housing that slides in a window frame, a continuous-rotation fan blade assembly in the center, and a prismatic vent slider on the side of the inner frame. Ensure the entire assembly is rendered in a uniform light gray plastic material.
captions.factory: The code constructs a window frame housing using a subtracted box primitive to create the hollow center. The inner fan frame is built with a similar hollowed box, detailed with horizontal and vertical cylinders forming the safety grille. The fan blade is modeled by combining a central cylinder hub with multiple extruded rectangular blades rotated around the axis. Finally, a prismatic vent slider is created from a simple box primitive, and all components are assembled with appropriate prismatic and continuous joints.
